arxiv-2304-05164.title: The Effect of Tail Stiffness on a Sprawling Quadruped Locomotion
arxiv-2304-05164.description: Abstract A distinctive feature of quadrupeds that is integral to their locomotion is the tail. Tails serve many purposes in biological systems including propulsion, counterbalance, and stabilization while walking, running, climbing, or jumping. Similarly, tails in legged robots may augment the stability and maneuverability of legged robots by providing an additional point of contact with the ground.

arxiv-2307-05682.title: Galaxy Quenching with Mass Growth History of Galaxy Groups and Clusters: The Importance of Post-Processing
arxiv-2307-05682.creator: So-Myoung Park, Kyungwon Chun, Jihye Shin, Hyunjin Jeong, Joon Hyeop Lee, Mina Pak, Rory Smith, Jae-Woo Kim
arxiv-2307-05682.description: Abstract We investigate the fraction of quenched satellite galaxies in host galaxy groups and clusters using TNG300 in the IllustrisTNG cosmological magnetohydrodynamical simulations. Simulations show that most satellites are quenched after they fall into their final hosts: post-processing is a more dominant mechanism of galaxy quenching than pre-processing.

pmc-10595604.creator: S Temam, N Billaudeau, S Kab, M Zins, M-N Vercambre
pmc-10595604.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundWhile noise at school is a well-known issue concerning students’ well-being, data on its potential effect on teachers’ health are limited.MethodsAmong teachers (n = 13,843) and a sample of non-education employees (n = 34,338) participating in the French CONSTANCES cohort (enrollment phase 2012-2020), we evaluated self-reported noise exposure at inclusion with the question “do you work in an environment where you sometimes have to raise your voice to talk to people 2 or 3 meters away?”(yes/no).

pmc-10626287.title: Comprehensive assessment of the efficacy and safety of a clay mask in oily and acne skin
pmc-10626287.creator: Xianghua Zhang, Zhongxing Zhang, Han Tao, Xiaofeng He, Kungchi Hsu, Wenna Wang, Xiaofeng Fang, Andrew Steel
pmc-10626287.description: BACKGROUND:Oily skin, characterized by excessive sebum production, can lead to acne and have psychosocial impacts due to changes in appearance. Recent research has shown interest in treatments for oil control, with kaolin and bentonite emerging as promising options. Despite their potential, comprehensive studies on these ingredients are still in the nascent stages.

pmc-10994603.title: The impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the mental health of patients diagnosed with inflammatory bowel diseases
pmc-10994603.creator: Oliviu-Florentiu Sarb, Vitalie Vacaras, Vladimir-Petru Filip, Adriana-Daniela Sarb, Roxana-Delia Zaharie, Nicu Draghici, Dafin-Fior Muresanu, Alina-Ioana Tantau
pmc-10994603.description: Understanding the profound impact of a viral pandemic on the mental health of patients with autoimmune diseases undergoing biological treatment is crucial for future insights. This cross-sectional case-control study aimed to assess the mental health implications of the COVID-19 pandemic on individuals with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) in Romania, spanning from November 2022 to March 2023.

pmc-11381798.title: Pingyangmycin-loaded drug-eluting beads transarterial embolisation for giant cavernous haemangioma of the liver: A case report
pmc-11381798.creator: Yonghua Bi, Jianzhuang Ren, Xinwei Han
pmc-11381798.description: PurposeCavernous haemangioma of the liver (CHL) is the most common venous malformation of the liver. Surgical resection is considered the gold standard for large symptomatic haemangiomas. Transarterial embolisation has demonstrated acceptable efficacy with lower rates of morbidity and mortality. We report the first case of a 59-year-old man with a giant CHL treated using pingyangmycin drug-eluting bead transarterial embolisation (DEB-TACE).

pmc-11561109.title: Chimpanzees employ context-specific behavioral strategies within fission–fusion societies
pmc-11561109.creator: Jake A. Funkhouser, Stephanie Musgrave, David Morgan, Severin Ndassoba Kialiema, Delon Ngoteni, Sean Brogan, Philip McElmurray, Crickette Sanz
pmc-11561109.description: Fission–fusion social systems allow individuals to make flexible choices about where, with whom, and in what contexts to spend their time in response to competing social and ecological pressures. The ability for fission–fusion societies to support individual behavioral strategies that vary across contexts has been suggested, but the potential function of such context-specific social choices remains largely understudied.

pmc-12559347.title: Assessment of the water and energy nexus in the energy supply subsystem of water stressed countries like Iran
pmc-12559347.creator: Masoud Vahabzadeh, Amir Molajou, Hossein Akbari Variani, Abbas Afshar
pmc-12559347.description: Iran, situated in the Middle East, is recognized as a prominent energy hub, with its economy heavily reliant on the exportation of energy. pmc-13359968.title: Integrated Genomic and Transcriptomic Analyses Suggest the Potential Involvement of the COBRA Gene Family in Heat, Drought and Combined Stress Responses in Phoebe bournei
pmc-13359968.creator: Ruobing Ying, Ronglin Liu, Yizhuo Feng, Duo Yu, Xinghao Tang, Kehui Zheng, Shijiang Cao
pmc-13359968.description: Simple SummaryPhoebe bournei is a valuable timber tree, but is under threat due to global warming. This study first identified 8 COBRA genes in Phoebe bournei, and has analyzed their evolutionary relationships, structural characteristics, tissue expression, and dynamic expression trends under stress conditions. Through WGCNA, which integrated transcriptome data and physiological data, we discovered four key potential candidates.

pmc-13589772.title: NGH分类辅助下的夏科氏肩关节病影像学评估与治疗
pmc-13589772.creator: 骁然 孙, 雨晨 贺, 晓磊 任, 威宏 朱
pmc-13589772.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). 夏科氏肩关节病是一种罕见的破坏性关节病，多继发于脊髓空洞症，常导致肩关节骨溶解与严重的上肢功能障碍。其诊疗难点不在于单纯识别关节破坏，而在于早期症状缺乏特异性，易与感染、肿瘤及炎症性关节病混淆；同时，肩胛盂与肱骨头骨破坏程度差异较大，传统的影像学描述难以为术前评估和治疗决策提供直接依据。NGH(neuropathic gleno-humeral degeneration)分类基于X线平片分别独立评估肩胛盂与肱骨头的退变程度，有助于减少影像描述的模糊性，为临床手术决策提供参考。现有证据提示，夏科氏肩关节病的临床处理应建立在综合评估的基础上：NGH分类辅助X线可用于初步诊断，磁共振成像(magnetic resonance imaging，MRI)可评价软组织等，CT+3D有助于骨缺损量化和假体规划；存在肿胀、积液、炎症指标升高或拟手术者，应结合关节穿刺、活检排除感染、肿瘤和炎症性疾病。对于关节破坏进入静止期的患者，可采取肩关节置换术等手术。未来仍需开展多中心、前瞻性队列研究及长期随访，以进一步验证NGH分类的临床价值，并明确肩关节置换术的长期疗效。

夏科氏肩关节病是一种因神经感觉缺陷而发生的慢性关节疾病[1-2]。其主要病因为脊髓空洞症(syringomyelia，SM)，其他病因包括梅毒、糖尿病及创伤等[3]。无痛性肿胀、关节活动度受限、肌力减弱等症状是该病的临床早期表现，中晚期可出现部分或全部感觉丧失、肩关节脱位及骨结构破坏等。

夏科氏肩关节病的临床处理目前面临多重困难。第一，早期症状不典型，患者容易被误诊为感染、肿瘤或炎症性关节病[1, 4-5]。第二，多数患者发现时已存在肱骨头和肩胛盂不同程度骨破坏，单纯使用“骨溶解严重”或“关节破坏明显”等描述难以指导后续影像评估和术前讨论。第三，由于夏科氏肩关节病发病率极低，且手术治疗证据主要来自病例报告，术式选择不能简单套用普通肩关节退变性疾病的治疗逻辑。

基于上述问题，本文介绍夏科氏肩关节病的主要发病机制、诊断路径及手术策略，重点聚焦NGH(neuropathic gleno-humeral degeneration)分类系统(该分类可根据影像学结果对不同损伤程度患者进行分层，独立评估肩胛盂与肱骨头的退变程度)辅助下的夏科氏肩关节病影像学评估与治疗，以期为临床诊断与综合治疗策略提供参考。

夏科氏肩关节病的流行病学特征与发病机制

流行病学特征

一项纳入39篇病例报告(共包含65例患者，71肩)的系统评价[6]显示，患者的发病年龄为(51.1±15.8)岁，女性略多于男性(女꞉男=1.2꞉1)。受累关节以单侧为主(90.8%)，左右两侧无显著差异，且绝大多数患者伴有关节活动度(range of motion，ROM)受限。27%的患者有创伤史，与无创伤史患者相比，诊断时间缩短69%[1]。

发病机制

夏科氏肩关节病是一种神经性关节病，多继发于SM。SM可继发于Arnold-Chiari等先天畸形，或由恶性肿瘤、脊髓损伤等因素引起[7]。Chiari Ⅰ畸形、SM和夏科氏肩关节病三者间的关系是临床上最主要的发病机制。

从分子机制来看，在夏科氏足(另一种神经性关节病)中，骨保护素(osteoprotegerin，OPG)、NF-κB受体活化因子(receptor activator of NF-κB，RANK)及NF-κB受体活化因子配体(receptor activator of NF-κB ligand，RANKL)三者所构成的通路会引起严重的骨吸收。骨吸收同样为夏科氏肩关节病的特征之一，故OPG/RANKL/RANK信号通路可能作为外推机制，为夏科氏肩关节病中可能存在的分子发病机制的研究提供参考。

Chiari Ⅰ畸形继发SM致夏科氏肩关节病的发病机制

Chiari Ⅰ畸形(患病率为3/10万~8/10万)主要特征为小脑扁桃体下疝，患者常伴头痛、肢体麻木及四肢轻瘫等症状[8-10]。小脑扁桃体下疝阻塞第四脑室出口，导致脑脊液循环受阻，异常压力传导至脊髓中央管，使65%~85%的患者在颈段或颈胸段(最常为C5~T1节段)形成纵行液腔，即SM[11-13]。空洞扩张破坏了脊髓前角运动神经元及前角间束内的交叉温痛觉纤维，导致患者出现上肢肌力减退及典型的分离性感觉障碍。20%~30%的SM患者会发展为夏科氏肩关节病[4, 6, 11, 14]。其主要机制为：肩关节失去感觉后，患者无法及时察觉日常活动中的反复创伤，如脱位、半脱位、骨折等[4]。由此进入失去神经保护的恶性循环，炎症激活、骨吸收增强、碎片形成、异常重建，最终导致关节破坏、肿胀、畸形(图1)。

Chiari I畸形继发脊髓空洞症在夏科氏肩关节病中的发病机制

Figure 1 Pathogenesis of syringomyelia secondary to Chiari I malformation in Charcot arthropathy of the shoulder

A: Chiari I malformation may obstruct cerebrospinal fluid flow and cause cervical syringomyelia, resulting in dissociated sensory loss, upper-limb weakness, and loss of protective sensation around the shoulder.
